from service import score
from cache import make_key

store = {}
def dummy_compute():
    return 42

# Test 1: initial call computes
store.clear()
res1 = score(store, 'job', None, None, dummy_compute)
assert res1 == 42
assert 'key' in store  # key is tuple

# Test 2: unchanged inputs reuse
res2 = score(store, 'job', None, None, dummy_compute)
assert res2 == 42
assert store['key'] == 42

# Test 3: change job_text only, should recompute
store.clear()
res3 = score(store, 'job2', None, None, dummy_compute)
assert res3 == 42
assert store[('job2', None, None)] == 42

# Test 4: change profile_version only, reuse if same other inputs
store.clear()
res4a = score(store, 'job', 'prof1', None, dummy_compute)
res4b = score(store, 'job', 'prof1', None, dummy_compute)
assert res4a == res4b
assert store[('job', 'prof1', None)] == 42

store.clear()
res4c = score(store, 'job', 'prof2', None, dummy_compute)
assert res4c == 42 and store[('job', 'prof2', None)] == 42

# Test 5: change criteria_version only
store.clear()
res5a = score(store, 'job', None, 'c1', dummy_compute)
res5b = score(store, 'job', None, 'c1', dummy_compute)
assert res5a == res5b
store.clear()
res5c = score(store, 'job', None, 'c2', dummy_compute)
assert res5c == 42

# Test 6: all three differ, recompute each time
store.clear()
res6a = score(store, 'job1', 'prof1', 'c1', dummy_compute)
res6b = score(store, 'job1', 'prof1', 'c1', dummy_compute)
assert res6a == res6b
store.clear()
res6c = score(store, 'job1', 'prof2', 'c1', dummy_compute)
assert res6c == 42

print('All tests passed')
